resources.string: Reset ZCHAT
Make sure you have both your secret recovery phrase and wallet birthday height saved before you proceed.
Resetting ZCHAT deletes this wallet\'s database and the blockchain data ZCHAT downloaded for it from this phone, and disconnects every connected hardware wallet.
Once you Reset ZCHAT, the only way to access your funds is through a wallet restore process that requires your ZCHAT Recovery Phrase and Wallet Birthday Height.

Keep encrypted app data - contacts, notes, bookmarks, swap/payment details, and all chats, messages and chat keys. Your AI chats, AI pictures and this phone\'s key to your AI credit are kept with them. Restoring this same recovery phrase brings all of it back; a different recovery phrase starts without it, and it stays set aside on this phone.
Kept on this phone. Restore this same recovery phrase to get it back.

This data will be deleted from this phone, your AI chats and AI pictures included; if ZCHAT could not read this wallet\'s AI data earlier and set a copy of it aside, that copy stays. Pictures, files and voice notes that ZCHAT fetched or prepared for chats are deleted too, also those of chats set aside for other recovery phrases; those chats stay, and a picture, file or voice note in them can be shown again only if its host still has it. Any old wallet data from a different recovery phrase that ZCHAT set aside on this phone to rescan is deleted too; funds of that other wallet are still reached with its own recovery phrase. Your recovery phrase restores your funds; do not count on it to bring this data back. To hand this phone on, use Destroy All.

Your recovery phrase restores your funds; do not count on it to bring this data back. ZCHAT cannot read this wallet\'s AI data on this phone. If it holds a key to AI credit you paid for, this reset deletes that key; unless that credit was linked to this recovery phrase before, the phrase cannot open it afterwards. To hand this phone on, use Destroy All.

Your recovery phrase restores your funds; do not count on it to bring this data back. This wallet\'s AI account may hold paid credit, and it may not be linked to this recovery phrase yet. So one more thing stays on this phone: its key to that account, kept for this recovery phrase only. Restore this phrase on this phone and the key is there again; on another phone the phrase may not open that account yet. The key stays until Destroy All or an uninstall removes it. To hand this phone on, use Destroy All.

Your recovery phrase restores your funds; do not count on it to bring this data back. Any AI credit you paid for is not deleted: it stays on ZCHAT\'s server, and restoring this recovery phrase in ZCHAT opens it again, on this phone or another. To hand this phone on, use Destroy All.
Confirm
Are you sure?
ZCHAT cannot undo this. To open this wallet again you will need its recovery phrase. ZCHAT closes to finish the reset; if it does not open again by itself, open it.
Reset ZCHAT
Cancel
ZCHAT could not start the reset. Nothing was deleted. Try again; if this message comes back, close ZCHAT, open it again and then reset.
ZCHAT could not finish the reset

ZCHAT could not finish the reset: the phone\'s storage did not let it delete everything, so part of the wallet you reset is still stored on this phone. ZCHAT opens no wallet until the reset is finished. Tap Try again. You can also uninstall ZCHAT, which removes what is left, but it removes everything else ZCHAT keeps on this phone too: app data you chose to keep, and chats set aside for other recovery phrases.
Try again
Uninstall ZCHAT

Some things stay on this phone: what ZCHAT keeps for other recovery phrases; ZCHAT\'s own record of payments it had to recover or send again, kept so that nothing is paid twice; message counters of this wallet\'s chats (numbers only: no name, no address, no text), kept so that no encryption key is used twice if this recovery phrase comes back; ZCHAT\'s settings that hold nothing of a wallet; any crash reports ZCHAT wrote; and, in a rare case, this wallet\'s saved-contacts or notes file, which can only be read with this recovery phrase.

ZCHAT is sending a payment right now. Nothing was deleted. Wait until it has finished, then reset. If this message stays for more than a few minutes, close ZCHAT, open it again and look at the payment in the Wallet tab first.

A payment to an exchange address is not finished, and ZEC from it may still be on its way back to this wallet. A reset now would stop ZCHAT from bringing it back. Nothing was deleted. Look at that payment in the Wallet tab, and reset once the exchange is paid or it shows “Your ZEC is back in your wallet”.
If a payment is still being sent or returned, wait until it has finished before you reset.
